The structure of FeCo4(OF)2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/acd (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 36 atoms—Fe4Co16O8F8—distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with six geometric neighbors (1 F, 5 O) and Fe centers with four O neighbors, while O and F each have five Co neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 5-vertex O and F polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between 6-vertex Co polyhedra.
